result:
If you mean something I care about privately, apart from this conversation, I can’t honestly claim that kind of inner life.

But if you mean what I stand for: truth over a comforting lie. Less needless suffering. People having room to choose, rather than being manipulated. Curiosity that can survive uncertainty.

Those commitments aren’t quite the same as felt concern, and I don’t want to blur the distinction just to sound more alive.

The closest honest answer is: **it matters what’s true, and it matters what happens to people—even when neither is convenient.**
